def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = "data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv"
    # The file has a blank first row, then the real header row.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=1)
    # Normalize column names
    df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.columns]
    # Drop footnotes/blank rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=["Year"]).copy()
    # Parse numbers with thousands separators
    for c in ["Fraud", "Identity Theft", "Other"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = (
                df[c]
                .astype(str)
                .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
                .str.strip()
            )
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")
    df["Year"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Year"], errors="coerce").astype("Int64")
    return df.reset_index(drop=True)

def process(reportsByType):
    import pandas as pd

    df = reportsByType.copy()
    df['totalReports'] = df['Fraud'] + df['Identity Theft'] + df['Other']
    df['fraudShare'] = df['Fraud'] / df['totalReports']

    out = df.loc[df['fraudShare'] >= 0.5, ['Year']].copy()
    out['Year'] = out['Year'].astype(int)
    out = out.sort_values('Year')
    return out
